workstreams.summary: Standardize ALL destructive confirmations on one shared inline-panel component and add a success-feedback pattern. Today there are 4 hand-rolled patterns (centered modal, inline card-replace panel, inline row swap, detached top banner) and no shared component. This fixes feedback #11: ChildList renders the archive confirm as a banner at the TOP of the list, far from the per-card Archive button, so on a long list the user does not see it and clicks repeatedly.

workstreams.blastRadiusNotes: Cross-feature UI refactor; presentational only — no service, API route, repository, schema, or seed change. New shared component lives in features/lib/front/components (client cross-feature import is the established pattern). Each migrated site keeps its existing handler (onDelete/onArchive/archiveChild/quranApi.deleteSession/handleReject/handleApprove). Biggest visual change is the feedback admin modals (overlay → inline row panel); the two modal components are deleted only after AdminFeedbackPage interaction tests pass. Tone convention: red = destructive (delete/void/reject), amber = reversible (archive/leave). Implement in dependency order: shared component first, then card-replace deletes (lesson/evidence/quran), then row-swap (void/leave), then ChildList archive fix (#11), then feedback conversion, then style-guide section 3 + section 9.
